title: Cassiodorus, Variae, Books III–XII / RU: Кассиодор, «Варии» (кн. III–XII) (RU-gap)
author: Magnus Aurelius Cassiodorus Senator (c. 485–c. 580)
genre: Chancery letters, edicts and model letters for appointments (formulae)
size: 468 documents in 12 books; Books III–XII c. 380 documents, est. 90–100k words
edition: Mommsen, MGH AA 12 (1894), public domain: https://archive.org/details/cassiodorisenato00cass. Fridh, CCSL 96 (1973)
ru_evidence: Only Books I–II (V. G. Izosin) on ancientrome.ru/antlitr/cassiodorus. ru.wikipedia lists no Russian translation of the Variae.
en_evidence: Bjornlie, The Variae (University of California Press 2019, complete); Barnish, TTH 1992 (selection); Hodgkin 1886 (abridged). Cited from memory; not re-checked online here.
other_translations: Italian complete with commentary (Giardina et al., L'Erma, 2014–2017; from memory, not verified here).
value: The primary documentary source for Ostrogothic Italy: administration, diplomacy (Clovis, Alaric II), economy, urban life and late Roman ideology of rule.
ai_feasibility: medium: inflated but formulaic chancery rhetoric; the English and Italian versions are available for verification.
pilot_unit: Book III (53 letters, incl. Theoderic's diplomatic letters of 507; est. 10–12k words)
